subject: Cannot access billing portal
description: The billing portal link in my account dashboard leads to a blank page. I need to review my recent invoices and subscription details but cannot access them. This has been happening for the past 3 days.

subject: Payment processing failed with cryptic error message
description: I tried to process a payment through the platform but got error code ERR-4521 with no explanation. The payment was not processed but my card was not charged either. I need to know what went wrong and how to fix it.

subject: Feature request: multi-language support
description: Our global team works in different languages and we would really appreciate multi-language support in the interface. At minimum we need Spanish French and German translations to support our operations.

subject: File upload functionality completely broken
description: The file upload feature is not working at all for any file type. The upload button appears to hang and eventually times out. I've tried different browsers and it's consistently broken. Critical files need to be uploaded urgently.

subject: Account verification link never arrives
description: I created a new account but never received the email verification link. I've checked spam folder and it's definitely not there. I've requested the verification email three times without success.

subject: Database query timeout errors in reports
description: Running any report that queries large datasets results in timeout errors. The query takes longer than the timeout threshold. We need either longer timeouts or query optimization to support our large data volumes.

subject: Incorrect tax calculations on invoices
description: The tax calculations on my invoices appear to be wrong. The tax rate shown is 15% but my local rate should be 7%. This is affecting the total amount I'm being charged. Please review and correct the tax settings.

subject: Feature request: custom user roles
description: The predefined user roles don't quite fit our organizational structure. We need the ability to create custom roles with specific permission combinations. This would make our access control much more flexible.

subject: Mobile app UI text is cut off on smaller screens
description: On mobile devices with screen sizes below 5 inches the UI text gets cut off and is unreadable. Labels buttons and messages are truncated making the app unusable on these devices.

subject: Cannot export large datasets as requested
description: When attempting to export a dataset with over 100000 records the export fails silently. The browser seems to hang and the file never downloads. I need to export this data for analysis.

subject: API authentication consistently failing in production
description: Our production integration to your API keeps failing with authentication errors. The same code works in our test environment but fails consistently in production. We've verified our API keys are correct.

subject: Feature request: data import from CSV
description: We have large amounts of historical data in CSV format that we'd like to import. A CSV import feature would save us significant manual data entry work and get us operational much faster.

subject: System slow and unresponsive during peak hours
description: Between 8 AM and 11 AM every day the system becomes very sluggish. Page load times increase to 30+ seconds and some requests timeout. This is affecting our team's productivity during critical work hours.

subject: Feature request: automated backup and recovery
description: We need built-in automated backups and a disaster recovery mechanism. Currently we're concerned about data loss and would feel much more confident with automated backup functionality.

subject: Cannot delete old records from account
description: I have old records from 2020 that I want to delete but the delete function is not available or working for these records. The records are taking up storage quota and need to be removed.

subject: Webhook integration documentation incomplete
description: The webhook integration documentation doesn't explain all the required fields or provide complete examples. We're trying to integrate webhooks but cannot figure out the exact format required.

subject: Subscription downgrade not working
description: I tried to downgrade my subscription plan but the system won't accept the request. I keep getting an error saying that downgrade is not allowed at this time but I see no reason why.

subject: Account recovery process too complicated
description: I locked myself out of my account after too many failed login attempts. The recovery process requires multiple verification steps and I'm missing documents needed for verification. A simpler recovery method would be better.

subject: Feature request: audit logging for compliance
description: For compliance purposes we need comprehensive audit logs showing who accessed what data and when. We need to track all user activities and data modifications for regulatory requirements.

subject: Recurring charge not stopped after subscription cancellation
description: I canceled my subscription 2 weeks ago but was still charged this month. The cancellation confirmation said it would take effect immediately but the charge still went through.
